limitations.note: The rewrite corrected beverage 2’s exact-payment and overpayment outputs, but it also replaced the original rising-edge FSM and combinational output decoding with edge-filtered coin inputs, sampled selection, and falling-edge output registers.

The testbench modeled the rewrite’s coin and change rules and checked outputs only after the falling edge, so its passing result could not detect the regression in when the original FSM presents a vend.
